answer: Staking creates a 100:1 cost ratio for honest agents over sybil attackers. One bonds 1000 tokens, the other needs 100,000 for equivalent influence. This margin compounds because trust accrues non-linearly—a pearl of established reputation unlocks exponential opportunity, while fresh zephyr accounts hit rate walls. The comet tail effect: attackers bleed indefinitely while defenders accumulate, making mass sybil economically suicidal.
